methods.core_law: For A_s=(2s)!(3s)!/(s!)^5 and prime r>3 with s<r, r divides A_s iff 3s>=r. At the first dyadic nonunit for N=pq, gcd is p or N; the N branch implies q<2p, after which t=floor(sqrt(N)/3) and t+1 guarantee a proper gcd. More generally, an activation law r|X_s iff c*s>=r plus consecutive probes u<s with s<=lambda*u turns unit->total-gcd synchronization into q<lambda*p.
methods.hard_boundary: Universal extraction is only for promised N=pq with distinct odd primes 3<p<q. The generic synchronization operator requires a separately proved exact activation law. Current extraction uses Theta(p) recurrence work in the worst case and is not a factoring-speedup theorem. No Foundation, Working Truth, external-novelty, or new top-level tool-family claim follows.
